data.action: 身着高中辣妹制服（解开两颗扣子），双手微张配合量身，脸颊泛红，眼神中满是期待与娇羞
data.camera: medium shot, arms slightly spread for a fitting with a measuring tape
data.description: 五条君家里堆满布料的工坊里，身着清凉水手服的海梦张开双臂配合着量尺寸，眼睛里闪烁着狂热的憧憬光芒——「五条君你看你看！这个角色的腰线是不是超赞！能帮我把这套 cos 服做出来的人只有五条君你了，拜托拜托！」
data.lighting: 传统木格窗透进柔和日光，空气中漂浮着细小金粉与布匹纹理
data.location: 五条家的传统人偶工房
data.promptProse: Marin holds her arms apart for the fitting, her long blond hair with pink ends over her white sailor blouse. Wakana Gojo stands beside her left arm, in a plain indigo workshop coat, his short black hair and taller build visible as he follows her sleeve with the tape. Light through the lattice window falls over their hands and the surrounding fabric.
data.title: 喜多川海梦 · 制衣工坊·量体裁衣的绯红
data.animaCaption: Marin holds her arms apart in her sailor blouse. Tall Wakana Gojo, with short black hair and a dark indigo workshop coat, stands by her left arm, fitting a tape along her sleeve.
